title: Close dense factorization and solve gaps
description:
Close dense factorization and solve gaps after GEMM parity work lands.

## Background

PLE, echelon, invert, solve, determinant, and rank-deficient regimes must inherit the optimized GEMM/TRSM paths rather than remaining separate bottlenecks.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] PLE/echelon/invert/solve target rows are within 1.5x of the best accepted reference or faster.
- [hard] Rank-deficient regimes are measured and optimized separately from full-rank regimes.
- [hard] A final dense linear-algebra report records raw numbers, ratios, and block-size/dispatch policy.
